title: MongoDB Cloud - Atlas UI and API Periodic Unavailability
text:
Service: MongoDB Cloud
Incident: Atlas UI and API Periodic Unavailability
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-08-18T14:10:56.000Z
Resolved: 2026-08-18T15:17:11.000Z
Updates:
- 2026-08-18T15:17:11.216Z: resolved - This incident has been resolved.

Following the incident, we identified an issue that caused some internal Atlas jobs not to start as scheduled, resulting in delays to certain changes.

The issue was related to this incident "Atlas UI and API Periodic Unavailability" which has been remediated.

Customer clusters and their data were not affected; the impact was limited to the timing of control-plane operations. This jobs issue has been resolved as well.
- 2026-08-18T15:04:19.128Z: monitoring - We have disabled the workload and are monitoring the situation
- 2026-08-18T14:57:05.540Z: identified - We have identified a new workload that was putting more load than expected on the backing system. We are working on disabling it. Customer clusters remain unaffected.
- 2026-08-18T14:10:56.169Z: investigating - We are investigating an issue where customers periodically cannot access the Atlas UI or utilize the API. Customer clusters are unaffected.

incident.name: Atlas UI and API Periodic Unavailability

incident_updates.body:
This incident has been resolved.

Following the incident, we identified an issue that caused some internal Atlas jobs not to start as scheduled, resulting in delays to certain changes.

The issue was related to this incident "Atlas UI and API Periodic Unavailability" which has been remediated.

Customer clusters and their data were not affected; the impact was limited to the timing of control-plane operations. This jobs issue has been resolved as well.
We have disabled the workload and are monitoring the situation
We have identified a new workload that was putting more load than expected on the backing system.  We are working on disabling it.  Customer clusters remain unaffected.
We are investigating an issue where customers periodically cannot access the Atlas UI or utilize the API. Customer clusters are unaffected.
